entries.value: "Rust-native mesh/SDF geometry kernel (#2621) — a declarative implicit CSG op-tree evaluated as a signed-distance field, polygonized (surface nets) to a watertight mesh, exported to binary STL. Metric (mm). Tauri-free; reached from a live session as the `bsc cad` subcommand (#3387). Foundation for the Design Studio's AI-authored 3D objects; icebox #2620 splits it into its own package."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# Library only — no `[[bin]]`. The standalone `bsc-cad` binary was retired in #3387: only `bsc` and
# `bsc-agent` are bundled with the app (tauri.conf.json `externalBin`), so a second sidecar was
# unreachable from a live session. `cli::run` is dispatched by the unified `bsc` binary, matching every
# other tool crate (bsc-shot, bsc-navigate, bsc-graph, bsc-ui, …). A WASM build reuses the same lib.
